This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, serial story arcs, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on September 4 across two hard-hitting newspaper crusades on Big Town starring Edward Pawley as Steve Wilson for Ironized Yeast (1945) and Lifebuoy Soap (1951), Maurice Tarplin narrating Death Has a Thousand Faces on The Mysterious Traveler, the biographical saga of shipping pioneer Robert Dollar on Captains of Industry, Curt Massey on The Gulf Spray Show, and California Gold Rush songs on How the West Was Sung, Edward Pawley & Fran Carlon (1945, 1951), Maurice Tarplin (1951), and Robert Dollar (1937–1974):
